entities.summary: Albert Mauer was a Polish football and ice hockey player who competed in the 1932 Winter Olympics. After returning from forced labour in 1947, he was a tennis, hockey, and football coach for teams including Polonia Bytom, Start Katowice, Górnik Katowice, KS Baildon Katowice, and Chemik Kędzierzyn.
